title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Palantir rallies 23% on ‘otherworldly’ quarterly results; Dow, S&P hit records on AI earnings - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Wall Street's benchmark S&P 500 and Dow Jones hit an intraday record high for the first time since early June on Tuesday, boosted by upbeat AI-driven forecasts from Caterpillar and Palantir ‌and hopes ⁠for ⁠an imminent deal to end tensions in the Middle East.

Palantir Technologies surged 16% in premarket trading after raising its annual revenue forecast, while ON Semiconductor gained 7.6% on a stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue outlook.

Caterpillar climbed 7.5% after its second-quarter profit nearly doubled, adding to upbeat sentiment as investors assess whether heavy AI spending is translating into returns. Strong results from Microsoft and Amazon last week have also supported Wall Street following a volatile July.

US stock index futures advanced on Tuesday after upbeat forecasts from Palantir and ON Semiconductor reinforced confidence in AI-driven demand. Investors also monitored developments in the Middle East and corporate earnings for clues about the health of the U.S. economy. Dow futures rose 343 points, or 0.64%, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures gained 0.20% and 0.78%, respectively.
